# AGROSALAS PERU S.R.L.

> Peruvian agro-industrial company that produces and exports canned foods: legumes (beans, lima beans, pigeon peas, chickpeas, zarandaja) and red bell pepper. Family-run, founded in 2021, with presence in Spain, the United States and Panama. B2B supplier for importers, distributors and retailers.

The site is bilingual. English pages live under `/en/`; the same pages in Spanish use the URL without the `/en` prefix (for example `/en/products` and `/products`). Every product is canned (category "Conservas"). Prices, formats and minimum order quantities are quoted on request.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://agrosalasperu.com/en): company overview and featured products
- [Product catalog](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/products): full list of canned products
- [About us](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/about): history, mission and values
- [Events](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/events): trade fairs and business meetings we take part in
- [Contact](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/contact): quote requests and contact form

## Products

- [Castilla Bean (Blackeye)](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/products/frijol-castilla): Peruvian castilla bean, cooked and preserved in brine.
- [Red Kidney Bean](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/products/frijol-rojo): canned red kidney bean, ready for multiple recipes.
- [Canary Bean](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/products/frijol-canario): canned canary bean with a smooth texture, for traditional dishes.
- [Black Bean](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/products/frijol-negro): black beans cooked in brine, ready to use.
- [Pigeon Peas in Water and Salt](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/products/gandul-agua-sal): pigeon peas cooked and preserved in salted water.
- [Pigeon Peas with Coconut](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/products/gandul-coco): pigeon peas cooked in coconut milk.
- [Dry Pigeon Peas](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/products/gandul-seco): selected dry pigeon peas, ready to cook.
- [American Lima Bean](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/products/pallar-americano): canned American lima bean.
- [Baby Lima Bean](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/products/pallar-bebe): Peruvian baby lima bean in brine.
- [Lima Bean in Brine](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/products/pallar-salmuera): Peruvian lima bean cooked and preserved in natural brine.
- [Bell Pepper](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/products/pimiento-morron): canned red bell pepper.
- [Zarandaja (Val Bean)](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/products/zarandaja): canned zarandaja, a versatile legume.
- [Chickpea](https://agrosalasperu.com/en/products/garbanzo): chickpea cooked in brine.
